nodes.label: Carbon and Ecosystem Services Markets
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Rewarding the Abundance of Life_ A Business Model for Environmental Stewardship and Mosaic Rights.md
nodes.rationale: One of three experimental market sectors — trading in carbon sequestration and watershed protection to reward sites for services like storm mitigation without requiring physical product sale

nodes.label: Environmental Livelihoods Markets
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Rewarding the Abundance of Life_ A Business Model for Environmental Stewardship and Mosaic Rights.md
nodes.rationale: One of three experimental market sectors — direct value-addition (seaweed soaps/shampoos, seedling sales from indigenous nurseries) converting ecological stewardship into manufacturing income

nodes.label: Knowledge and Education Markets
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Rewarding the Abundance of Life_ A Business Model for Environmental Stewardship and Mosaic Rights.md
nodes.rationale: One of three experimental market sectors — structured paid internships and exportable curricula as specialist environmental training, converting expertise into revenue stream
